result.question: Quais municípios com mais de 1000 internações têm taxa de internação em UTI mais de duas vezes acima da média nacional?
result.gold_sql: WITH media_nacional AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti_nacional FROM internacoes) SELECT mu.nome, mu.estado, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_uti_local, ROUND(mn.taxa_uti_nacional, 2) AS taxa_uti_nacional FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d, media_nacional mn GROUP BY mu.nome, mu.estado, mn.taxa_uti_nacional HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 2 * mn.taxa_uti_nacional ORDER BY taxa_uti_local DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: WITH media_nacional AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_ref FROM internacoes ), por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ) SELECT pm.municipio, pm.total_internacoes, ROUND(pm.taxa_uti, 2) AS taxa_uti FROM por_municipio pm, media_nacional mn WHERE pm.taxa_uti > 2 * mn.taxa_ref ORDER BY pm.total_internacoes DESC;
